sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule brown to chocolate brown (the original records a greenish tinge); antennae becoming paler towards the apex; postclypeus pale chestnut brown; pronotum slightly paler than the head, with a pale yellow T-shaped mark; abdominal tergites and sternites pale chestnut brown. Head and body densely hairy. Body length with wings 11.00—11.50 mm, without wings 6.00—8.90 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (length to mandible base 0.75—0.85 mm, width including compound eyes 0.90—0.95 mm). Fontanelle plate small, longitudinal, slit-like. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2 and about as long as segment 4. Compound eyes subcircular (maximum diameter 0.18—0.20 mm, minimum diameter 0.15—0.18 mm); about half their short diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli oval (length 0.10—0.12 mm, width 0.08—0.09 mm); separated from the compound eye by their own width. Postclypeus inflated, hairy; about half as long as wide, divided into two halves by the median line. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head (length 0.48—0.55 mm, width 0.75—0.80 mm); anterior margin slightly raised and concave, with a shallow median notch; posterior margin with a distinct notch. Wings dark grey; margins hairy, membrane weakly hairy; microsculpture consisting of a row of papillae on the anterior margin and a row of smaller papillae on the posterior margin, the surface with non-stellate (5—6 arms) and stellate (6—8 arms) microstars.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to straw yellow; antennae and labrum slightly paler than the head; mandibles dark red-brown; body white. Head sparsely hairy, body more densely hairy. Body length 4.10—5.60 mm. Head capsule subrectangular (length to mandible base 1.35—1.40 mm, maximum width 1.00—1.05 mm, width/length index 0.72—0.75); sides undulate; frontal protuberance obtusely rounded, its anterior margin straight in lateral view and rather hairy. Antennae 14-segmented; segments 2 and 3 subequal, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of labrum deeply concave, with pointed corner-like projections on both sides (length 0.35 mm, median length 0.18—0.23 mm, maximum width 0.25—0.30 mm). Mandibles long, slender, rod-like, about as long as or slightly longer than the head (length 1.35—1.45 mm, left mandible length/head length index 1.00—1.04); apex pointed, weakly incurved. Postmentum rod-like (length 0.45—0.48 mm, maximum width 0.28—0.33 mm, minimum width 0.18—0.20 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped; both anterior and posterior margins weakly concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to straw yellow; antennae, labrum and legs paler than the head; postclypeus concolorous with the head. Head moderately hairy, body densely hairy. Body length 4.00—4.50 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandible base 0.70—0.80 mm, maximum width 0.80—0.90 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segments 3 and 4 subequal and shortest. Postclypeus inflated, hairy; longer than half its width (length 0.25—0.30 mm, width 0.45—0.50 mm). Pronotum as in the soldier but with both margins lacking a notch (length 0.20—0.25 mm, width 0.50—0.55 mm).

note: Adapted from the entry in Chhotani (1997), original in English; soldier, worker and alate are all present; synonymy list, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated. The paratype alate recorded in the original is much paler than the original description, and that passage on colour variation is not translated.
